title: Disney+ UK Creative Asset
description: Creative assets accepted by Disney+ Standard with Ads in the UK. Source: Disney Advertising 'Disney+ Video Commercial EMEA' spec (English PDF, updated 2025-11-19) and Disney Advertising EMEA newsroom statements, retrieved 2026-08-20. Only linear video commercials (pre-roll/mid-roll) are supported in the UK; interactive/pause/shoppable formats are unverified for the UK and intentionally not accepted.

video.title: Video track
video.description: Exactly one video track is permitted and must match the audio duration.

codec.description: Apple ProRes or H.264. When H.264, profile High is required.

h264Profile.description: Required only for H.264 files; the EMEA spec fixes profile to High.

frameRate.description: Native frame rate only; duplicate frames not allowed; remove any pull-down added for broadcast.

scanType.description: Adaptive deinterlace with no frame blending.

colorSpace.description: Video color space cannot be 'unknown' or None.

audio.title: Audio track
audio.description: Audio is required: exactly one track, 2-channel stereo, must match the video duration.

javascriptAllowed.description: VAST tags cannot contain JavaScript elements.

siteServed.description: Site-served creatives are accepted (availability table: Site-Served = Yes on Desktop/Mobile/Apps/OTT; the EMEA spec references a 'VAST & Site-served Video Spec' companion document).

verificationPixels.description: 1x1 verification pixels from Disney+ approved vendors.

approvedVendorsOnly.description: VAST served from Disney+ approved vendors only.

assetType.description: The only creative asset type with an official Disney+ EMEA/UK spec.

aspectRatio.description: Required aspect ratio for the UK/EMEA market.

placement.description: Pre-roll and mid-roll positions only per the EMEA spec.

clickableCTAStylingAllowed.description: CTA buttons that look clickable (e.g. 'Learn More', 'Buy Now') are not allowed.

audienceLevel.description: URLs/hashtags/QR codes/social handles accepted for 18+ profiles only; not accepted for 17 & under.

safetyZoneTopRightPx.description: Keep the top-right 220x135 px of 1920x1080 clear; the player overlays an 'Ad' logo and countdown there.

leadersAllowed.description: No leaders such as slates or countdowns.

letterboxing.description: Letterboxing/pillarboxing permitted on a case-by-case basis.

turnaroundBusinessDays.description: Up to 5 business days lead time from receipt of final assets.

thirdPartyTrackingMayBeRestricted.description: User privacy data restrictions may limit where third-party hosted and tracked creatives can serve (GDPR-relevant in UK/EU).
